title: Quarterly Goalmap & Risk Backlog — Hosted API + Model Catalog (Q3 planning)
creator: Arielle Chen
description: Purpose: Create a consolidated quarter-level Goalmap that ties Hosted API product milestones to model-catalog gating, verification, and rollout guardrails. Deliverables: 1) OKR-aligned initiative list with success metrics; 2) prioritized risk/backlog register (technical, data, customer, capacity); 3) cross-team sync playbook and canary schedule; 4) acceptance criteria and monitoring dashboards for each initiative. Scope: Hosted API feature changes (billing/quotas, streaming stability, structured output), model catalog additions (new verified model profiles, quantization recommendations, compatibility matrix), and the cross-cutting rollout policies (fallbacks, cost routing). Why now: Q3 commitments to enterprise SLAs and Dedicated capacity uptick require coordination between Serving, Runtime, and Catalog onboarding to avoid regressions in latency/cost and customer-impacting model behavior.
success_metrics: Reduced model-onboard time from PR->verified < 3 weeks
95th percentile generation latency within SLA for 90% of routes
Cost per 1M tokens for standard routes reduced by 12% via batching/quantization guidance
No high-severity customer regressions during canary rollouts
okrs_mapping: O1: Make inference predictable — KR1: Add 6 verified model profiles in catalog; KR2: Implement per-route cost breakdown in Console
O2: Reduce time-to-ship for model-enabled features — KR1: Cut model onboarding time to <3 weeks; KR2: Automate 50% of compatibility checks
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: New model quantization causes quality regression — Mitigation: mandatory eval sets + quality regression alerting tied to prompt suites
Risk: Capacity mismatch during canary -> Mitigation: reserve Dedicated ramp buffer + automated fallback to lower-capacity model variant
Risk: Conflicting priorities between Hosted API and Dedicated roadmap — Mitigation: prioritized triage with SRE/product sync and escalation path
